# elevenlabs.ge - Voice AI, Georgian Audio Synthesis & Voice Cloning

> elevenlabs.ge is Georgia's specialized resource and consulting hub for ElevenLabs technology, Georgian Text-to-Speech (TTS), AI voice cloning, conversational agents, and corporate audio branding, curated by Giorgi Basilaia.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Georgian AI Voice Synthesis](https://elevenlabs.ge/): Ultra-realistic, emotional Georgian speech generation powered by ElevenLabs multilingual generative voice models.
- [Instant & Professional Voice Cloning](https://elevenlabs.ge/): Cloning authentic human voices from short audio samples for corporate spokespersons, narrators, and audiobooks.
- [Voice Agents & Interactive Bots](https://elevenlabs.ge/): Ultra-low-latency bidirectional conversational voice bots for Georgian customer care and automated call dispatching.
- [Corporate Audio Production](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Video localization, podcast master polishing, e-learning narration, and dynamic game audio.
